title: Why You Freeze Before Starting Work

visual.description: Close up of hands frozen over a glowing computer keyboard in a dimly lit workspace as a cursor blinks on a blank screen.

vo.en: You are stuck in task paralysis. When a goal feels too vague, your primal brain interprets it as physical danger.

visual.description: Extreme macro shot of a man's eye opening wide with pupil dilating under dramatic high-contrast lighting.

vo.en: Your emotional amygdala hijacks your prefrontal cortex, triggering an automatic freeze response before you even begin.

visual.description: Stylized 3D rendering of glowing neural pulses firing rapidly through brain synapses in deep blue and amber tones.

vo.en: Staring blankly at your screen is literally your nervous system trying to protect you from failure.

visual.description: Macro slow motion shot of nervous fingers rhythmically tapping against a dark wooden table next to a notebook.

vo.en: The counter-intuitive fix is lowering the bar. Shrink your next step until your brain cannot justify fear.

visual.description: A male hand firmly presses down the top button of an analog steel stopwatch as the needle starts ticking.

vo.en: Never plan the whole project. Just open the tab and write a single terrible sentence.

visual.description: Close-up over the shoulder of a man opening his laptop lid in soft morning window light while picking up a mug.

vo.en: Momentum kills anxiety. Follow to spot your mental blindspots, and remember that...

visual.description: A confident man walking forward in silhouette against an open golden sunrise horizon.
